review_candidates.description: Missions Principales Mise en œuvre des procédés de rodage : Réaliser les opérations de rodage (manuel, conventionnel et numérique sur CNC) d'après les gammes de fabrication et les plans spécifiques. Suivi de la production et ajustements : Piloter les paramètres machines et réguler manuellement l'effort d'appui pour atteindre le niveau de tolérance requis. Assurer le montage et l'ajustement des outils abrasifs (pierres, meules). Contrôle conformité et démarche Qualité : Inspecter visuellement la qualité des pièces, détecter les dérives de production et signaler toute anomalie technique ou documentaire. Organisation et vie de l'atelier : Gestion du temps : Organiser sa journée de travail en autonomie afin de respecter les objectifs de production et les priorités transmises. Entretien du poste : Réaliser la maintenance préventive de premier niveau des équipements. Progrès permanent et HSE : Contribuer activement aux chantiers d'amélioration de l'atelier tout en travaillant dans le respect absolu des consignes de sécurité et d'environnement. Compétences Techniques (Savoir-faire) Lecture de plans complexes : Maîtrise de la cotation fonctionnelle et géométrique (GD&T). Technologie des abrasifs : Excellente connaissance des types de grains, liants et fluides de coupe/rodage selon les matériaux (titane, aciers spéciaux, traitements thermiques). Sensibilité mécanique "au toucher" : Aptitude indispensable pour ressentir l'effort de coupe lors du rodage manuel et ajuster la pression. Utilisation d'appareils de métrologie de pointe : Maîtrise des outils de mesure d'alésages au micron près. Maîtrise du langage CNC : Bases en programmation ou réglage sur commandes numériques. Qualités Professionnelles (Savoir-être) Rigueur et Précision chirurgicale : Le droit à l'erreur est quasi nul sur des pièces aéronautiques à forte valeur ajoutée. Patience et Concentration : Le rodage est une opération de finition minutieuse qui demande une attention visuelle et tactile constante. Culture Qualité & Transparence : Capacité à déclarer immédiatement un "loupé" ou une anomalie (primordial pour la sécurité aérienne). Autonomie et Gestion des priorités : Savoir organiser son poste de travail pour respecter les flux de production tendus. Profil Recherché (Formation & Expérience) Formation : Bac Pro Technicien en Réalisation de Produits Mécaniques (ex-TU), Titre Professionnel d'Usiner, ou CQPM (Certificat de Qualification Paritaire de la Métallurgie) d'Opérateur régleur sur machine-outil. Expérience : Une première expérience (2 à 5 ans) en usinage de précision (rectification, rodage ou ajustage) est souvent exigée. Une expérience préalable dans un secteur à fortes contraintes (aéronautique, spatial, médical, sport automobile) est un sérieux atout. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do. At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful. When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives. Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world. Job Description: About the role: The Manager, International Tax Reporting and Compliance will assist with the international and Canadian tax reporting and compliance function, which includes foreign affiliate reporting, surplus balances, adjust cost base (ACB) and foreign accrual property income (FAPI) calculations. What will you do? Responsible for certain aspects of Canadian tax reporting and compliance with respect to Sun Life's international operations, including: Preparing FAPI calculations for tax returns and quarterly tax provision purposes; Maintaining tax attributes of Sun Life’s foreign affiliates, such as ACB and surplus balances; and Analyzing excluded property status of relevant foreign affiliates Supporting Global Tax Advisory in developing, evaluating and implementing tax strategies to minimize Sun Life's tax liability worldwide Keeping apprised of changes in accounting and financial reporting and tax law to ensure tax implications are understood and communicated Performing tax research and interpretation of the impact of specific issues and/or transactions Preparing formal responses to queries from tax authorities Working with junior staff and/or outsourcers Responsibility for tax reporting and tax compliance for certain Canadian legal entities as required What do you need to succeed? A minimum of four (4) years of experience in tax including at least two (2) years in public accounting with Canadian international tax compliance and/or consulting experiences A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree – preferrable in Accounting or a related field of study. Knowledge of the Canadian Controlled Foreign Corporate (CFC) regime, including provisions in the Income Tax Act and Regulations regarding foreign affiliate tax rules Working well in a team; ability to collaborate with cross-functional team members and communicate clearly and efficiently. Excellent analytical, problem solving and planning skills; ability to attend to details and identify levers and deliver on opportunities Good project management skills, with ability to coordinate workflow for outsourcing arrangements and secondments Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, presentations) with the ability to communicate cross functionally Experience with Excel (proficient with Pivot Tables and V/X-look ups) Preferred Skills: Holding a CPA designation is an asset Financial institutions taxation experience, including complex multinational corporations and financing structures, acquisitions, divestitures and reorganizations, is an asset Experience with Gen AI tools (Ex. Microsoft Copilot) What's in it for you? Hybrid work environment A friendly, collaborative, and inclusive culture 20 vacation days per year Flexible Benefits from the day you join to meet the needs of you and your family Pension, stock and savings programs to help build and enhance your future financial security The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential Access to our Global Learning Centre, available 24/7 for your learning needs Wellness programs that support the three pillars of your health – mental, physical and financial Recent Awards: We are honoured to be recognized as a 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 Best Workplaces in Canada by Great Place to Work® Canada Great Place to Work® list for Best Workplaces for #HybridWork 2022 Great Place to Work® list for Best Workplaces for Professional Development in Canada 2022 Named “Best Places to Work” by Glassdoor, 2021 and 2023 The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com. We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you. We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling. We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Salary Range: 90,000/90 000 - 140,000/140 000 Job Category: Finance Posting End Date: 20/09/2026

review_candidates.title: MEP Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Company Description Dussmann Gulf Sole Proprietorship LLC is a leading subsidiary of the globally recognized Dussmann Group, bringing over 60 years of international expertise in integrated facilities management to the UAE. Established in 2005 in Abu Dhabi, the company has grown rapidly, now employing more than 3,000 professionals and delivering projects across the country. Dussmann Gulf provides comprehensive Integrated Facility Management Solutions, including Soft and Hard Services, hospitality support, specialized healthcare cleaning, disinfection and sanitization, pest control, and elevator and vertical transport maintenance. These services are tailored to commercial, residential, healthcare, educational, hospitality, government, and transportation sectors, with a strong focus on quality, safety, and efficiency. With certifications such as OHSAS 45001, EN ISO 9001, EN ISO 14001, and EN ISO 50001, Dussmann Gulf emphasizes excellence, sustainability, and innovation in all operations. Role Description The MEP Supervisor role is a full-time, on-site position based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The MEP Supervisor will oversee day-to-day mechanical, electrical, and plumbing activities within assigned facilities, ensuring all systems operate safely, efficiently, and in line with company standards. Responsibilities include managing site supervision and inspections, coordinating maintenance teams, monitoring building services performance, and ensuring compliance with relevant codes and client requirements. The role involves planning and scheduling preventive and corrective maintenance, reviewing contractor work, preparing technical reports, and supporting continuous improvement of facility management processes. The MEP Supervisor will collaborate closely with clients, internal stakeholders, and vendors to ensure timely resolution of issues and high levels of service delivery. Qualifications Strong site supervision and site inspection skills, with proven experience overseeing MEP works and ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards. Hands-on expertise in facility management (FM), including coordination of Hard Services and building systems operations within commercial or mixed-use facilities. Practical knowledge of plumbing systems and building maintenance, including troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions for MEP assets. Experience in managing maintenance teams, contractors, and vendors, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Diploma or degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Services Engineering, or a related technical field. Familiarity with relevant UAE regulations, standards, and HSE practices in facilities management. Proficiency in using CMMS or related maintenance management software and basic MS Office applications. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in diverse, multicultural teams. review_candidates.title: Lead Sales Operations Analyst
review_candidates.description: Primary Duties / Responsibilities: Analyzing and structuring complex sales transactions to align with company policies and customer needs. Evaluating deal profitability, risk, and compliance. Oversight of other analysts, and for training and process improvement within the deal desk itself. Providing guidance and support to sales teams on deal structuring, pricing, and approvals. Working closely with sales, finance, legal, sales operations, and other departments to ensure deal is structured according to corporate policies. Coordinating approvals and resolving issues cross functionally Streamlining deal desk processes and workflows to improve efficiency and reduce sales cycle times. Identifying and implementing best practices for deal management. Analyzing deal data, and creating reports to provide insight into deal pipeline and performance. Ensuring deals comply with company policies, legal requirements, and revenue recognition standards. Identifying and mitigating potential risks associated with deals. Work with a sense of urgency and quickly identify root cause of issues in process, policy, system, data and engage with functional owners to resolve. Collect data and information to further standardize the deal formation process. Identify opportunities to automate elements of the deal desk and improve operational execution. Preferred Qualifications: Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Related Work Experience Ability to interact effectively with executives, functional peer groups and subordinates to gain commitment and cooperation from others, especially those in other departments with competing priorities Excellent oral and written communications skills, as well as excellent presentation skills; ability to lead meetings internally and externally and executive briefings. Often takes a leading role in senior level presentations with management teams Ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel Understanding of cross functional process knowledge to drive efficiency into quote to cash processes Strives to improve performance and to have a significant impact on department’s success Demonstrates strong analytical skills Articulate compelling qualitative and quantitative business cases for process improvement Effectively gives direction to team members to accomplish complex deals Functional/Technical (education, certifications, and training) Bachelor’s degree/MBA from an accredited college/university in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, or a related field 3-5 years of Operations experience 2-4 years of experience in a process improvement focused environment Consulting experience preferred Knowledge of Oracle CRM system Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. NY generally ranges: $116,936-$175,404 CA generally ranges: $133,307-$199,961 All other locations fall under our General State range: $116,936-$175,404 Benefits may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Cloud Software Group and the country where you work. U.S. based employees are typically offered access to healthcare, life insurance and disability benefits, 401(k) plan and company match, among others.
